audioDescription: Silent. No music, voiceover or sound effects.
limitations: Illustrative procedural scene: 'holographic light' is approximated solely by scanline density (integer line spacing 2-9 px); no physical light transport, blur, bloom or particles.
Density shifts are quantised to integer row spacings, so light changes step rather than glide (intentional for pixel-aligned crispness).
Backing store fixed at DPR 1 to keep 1px rows pixel-exact; on high-DPI displays the canvas is upscaled by CSS.
Path lengths for contour reveal come from an offscreen SVG getTotalLength; requires a DOM browser runtime.
Copy is rendered as DOM overlays in Menlo/Consolas/monospace system fonts; exact glyph metrics vary by platform.
Captions and the IDEA label are DOM text overlays above the Canvas 2D scene (accessibility tradeoff from the technology review); all scene geometry is Canvas 2D.
